1932, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTESOOK NO. 5.
Page 58 Cont.
July 29 Mrs. Mary Chapp - 79 - ailing toe .... Geo Conley - 10 - blood poison .... Alice Conley - 33 - Enemic .. Mary Drz. - Successful operation for cataracts - can see again.
Theo. M. Student ... . Pneumonia .... Alsza Dresden - Threatened cancer Herman A. Schmidt - non C .- Rhum.
Blank Page
Page 59 Page 60 Aug. Winnthrop Hickey - 19 - blind in right eye ever since birth - hopes to improve .....
1932, August
Mary Meyers - 58 - Convert - deaf - married by Justice of peace to a Jew - good man but no religion. ...
Callan - Pat. - 31 - threatened with deportation - has wife & 2 small children - wife may stay $20. .. ...
Helen Dingell - 19 - threatened I.B. - only one of 4 orphans work- ing ....
Angeline Pokryfki - 33 - very threatening cancer - Has husband & 6 small children.
Charles Gellelen - 14 - Armenian boy stutters.
Miss Keegan - Port Huron (45) Head aches
Grances Schenk - 17 - N.C. - only daughter now in Kiefer Hospital - Father out of work
Bank failed ... that we may get something out of it.
Aug. 11 Mrs. Anna Brennan - 41 - of H.P. - going to Hosp'l to have cancer- ous breast removed - enrolled To-day one year - promises daily com- munion for year if breast is saved - & spared to her fam. of four
